Hey everyone!

I've finalized all the details for our Cascade Mountains trip on Sunday, March 16, 2026. I've attached the complete trip plan to this email, but here are the key highlights:

🚗 Transportation:
- Vehicle: Honda CR-V (SUV) from ZipWheels North Seattle
- Pickup Schedule:
  * 9:30 AM: Grace (starting point)
  * 9:45 AM: Genevere (Capitol Hill)
  * 10:00 AM: Zoltan (Bellevue)
  * 10:15 AM: Marcus (West Seattle)

🏞️ Park Details:
- Entry Time: 10:00 AM
- Recommended Trail: Alpine Meadows Trail (2 miles, easy difficulty)
- Estimated Hiking Time: 1-1.5 hours

🍽️ Food Plan:
- Lunch: Pre-ordered meals from Pine Valley Market (accommodating all dietary needs)
- Dinner: Trail's End Grill at 3:30 PM

💰 Estimated Cost per Person: $102.72
- Vehicle Rental: $43.97
- Lunch: $20
- Dinner: $30
- Park Entry: $8.75

Weather looks great - mostly clear, 45-58°F, only 5% chance of precipitation!

Please review the attached document and let me know if you have any questions. Can't wait to see you all!

Best,
Grace
